items.title: Completed-bar frontier ADVANCES one bar (2026-08-04 → 2026-08-05) while intraday breadth FLIPS broad → narrow across the 60 threshold, front vol RE-EXPANDS, and dealer positive-gamma THINS toward flat into a down-auction close: from the pre-close 2026-08-05 read (still on the FROZEN 08-04 bar) to this after-hours 2026-08-05 read on the newly COMPLETED 08-05 bar, the swing frontier advances (508 → 509 bars; dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate 08-04 → 08-05, 291/291 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), yet breadth deteriorates from broad 62.16% (margin +2.16) to narrow 50.99% (margin -9.01, now BELOW the 60 threshold), SPY front atmIV RE-EXPANDS 16.76% → 19.3% (expected move ±4.79 → ±5.5), signed net GEX THINS further +2.687B → +0.313B (~-88%, sign held positive), the flip rises 768.16 → 769.1, and spot closes a Trend day · down auction below VWAP 772.86 at 769.79, slipping off the 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0 → -0.2) while the VIX band stays calm (15.7 → 15.8, score 0).
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior 'gamma-thins-with-IV-easing-and-band-narrowing-on-FROZEN-frontier' axis: that axis required the completed-bar frontier to be UNCHANGED and paired thinning gamma with front vol EASING and breadth HOLDING broad. THIS axis is the frontier-ADVANCING mirror — the frontier moves forward by exactly one completed bar, and on that new bar breadth FLIPS from broad to sub-threshold narrow, front vol RE-EXPANDS (not eases), and gamma thins toward flat as the tape closes a down auction off the 52-week high. It is also distinct from a plain frontier-advance persistence axis (which says nothing about breadth, front vol, or gamma) and from a pure breadth-deterioration axis (which does not require a frontier advance or a front-vol re-expansion). Emit only when the completed-bar frontier ADVANCES by exactly one bar AND breadth crosses DOWN through the 60 threshold (broad → narrow) AND front atmIV / expected move RE-EXPAND AND signed net GEX thins materially with the sign held positive AND the close is a down auction (spot below VWAP) off or away from the 52-week high — so a re-read on a frozen frontier, a breadth improvement, an easing of front vol, a gamma thickening, or an up-auction close does not trip this flag.
items.method: Add a 'frontier-advances-with-breadth-flip-and-front-vol-reexpansion-into-down-auction-close' composite test that compares the prior-window (pre-close) read to the current (after-hours) read while asserting the completed-bar frontier ADVANCED by one bar (dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate moves 2026-08-04 → 2026-08-05 with freshSymbolCount==symbolCount==291, carriedSymbolCount==0, missingSymbolCount==0, and swing bars 508 → 509). Assert FIVE joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER ADVANCES — expectedSessionDate increments by one session and swing bars increment (508 → 509); (2) BREADTH FLIPS DOWN — market-heatmap breadthPct falls from >=threshold to <threshold (62.16 → 50.99, margin +2.16 → -9.01, leadership broad → narrow); (3) FRONT VOL RE-EXPANDS — options-structure atmIV rises (0.1676 → 0.193) and expectedMove rises (4.79 → 5.5); (4) GAMMA THINS TOWARD FLAT — signedNetGEX falls materially (2.687B → 0.313B, ~-88%) with the sign staying positive and the flip rising (768.16 → 769.1); (5) DOWN-AUCTION CLOSE OFF THE HIGH — intraday sessionType is 'Trend day · down' with spot below VWAP (769.79 < 772.86) and bench pctFrom52wHigh weakens (0 → -0.2). Fire only when all five hold jointly; any single miss (frozen frontier, breadth up, vol easing, gamma thickening, up-auction) suppresses the flag.
